question: As of May 2020, who among the following has become the world’s highest paid female athlete according to Forbes magazine report?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naomi Osaka**__.

__
 
• **Japanese tennis star Naomi Osaka, 22, has become the world's highest-paid female athlete**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Forbes, Osaka is ranked 29th among the 100 highest-paid athletes, while Venus Williams is ranked 33rd.
 
 
• Naomi Osaka was only one year old when Serena Williams won her first Grand Slam title in 1999.
 
• Nineteen years later, Osaka won her first Grand Slam, defeating Williams in the final of the US Open.
 
• Osaka earned $37.4 million in prize money and advertising over the past 12 months, $1.4 million more than Williams.
 
• The winner of the 2018 US Open and the 2019 Australian Open, Osaka has secured lucrative deals with global brands such as Procter & Gamble, All Nippon Airways and Nissin.
 
• Osaka has played in the main draw of the US Open four times.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sharapova was No. 1 from 2011-15, with Williams sitting atop the list from 2016-19.
 
 
• Maria Sharapova previously held the record with $29.7 million in 2015.
 
 
 
• **Forbes **is an American business magazine owned by Integrated Whale Media Investments and the Forbes family. 
 
 
• **Its headquarters is located in Jersey City, New Jersey. **
 
 
 
• Forbes also reports on related subjects such as technology, communications, science, politics, and law. 
 
• Forbes has an international edition in Asia as well as editions produced under license in 27 countries and regions worldwide.
